name: playwright-example
description: Playwright executable-stories example (file link to monorepo package)

scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {execSync}=require('child_process');const p=require('path').resolve(process.cwd(),'../../packages/executable-stories-playwright/package.json');if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.log('Skipping test: executable-stories-playwright not in workspace');process.exit(0);}execSync('playwright test',{stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.type-check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {execSync}=require('child_process');const path=require('path');const pkg=path.resolve(process.cwd(),'../../packages/executable-stories-playwright');if(!fs.existsSync(path.join(pkg,'package.json'))){console.log('Skipping type-check: executable-stories-playwright not in workspace');process.exit(0);}if(!fs.existsSync(path.join(pkg,'dist/index.d.ts')))execSync('pnpm --filter executable-stories-playwright run build',{stdio:'inherit'});execSync('tsc --noEmit',{stdio:'inherit'});"
